facts.title: grilled zucchini ribbons with pesto and white beans
ingredients: 1 1/4 to 1 1/2 pounds zucchini, thinner longer ones are ideal here
1 3/4 cups (from 1 15-ounce can) small-to-medium-sized white beans, drained
A 2-ounce bundle of basil (this is the small clamshell size at most groceries)
facts.yield_text: 2 as a main, 4 as a side
facts.author: Deb Perelman
